name: SysMon Power
tagline: CPU, GPU, memory, battery and power telemetry
description: SysMon Power shows live system and power telemetry in the style of a hardware monitor: CPU and GPU temperatures with usage bars and history graphs, memory pressure with compressed, cached and swap detail, uptime and connected devices, plus a power panel with battery level, significant energy apps, battery temperature, system and battery watts, time remaining and battery health.
